commands: echo "RUN_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_ID ATTEMPT=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS REPO=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"; echo "---base_branch---"; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main 2>&1; echo "---live_progress---"; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_review.live_progress_comment_enabled true 2>&1

gh pr diff 1142 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1142/run/diff.patch; grep -c '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1142/run/diff.patch; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1142/run/diff.patch

for f in lib/efficiency-trace.jq lib/test/modules/review-and-fix-contract.sh skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/references/convergence.md skills/review-and-fix/references/loop-exit.md skills/review/phases/phase-3-agents.md skills/review/phases/phase-0-3-6-blocker-recheck.md; do echo "===== $f ====="; grep -nE "skills/\*\*|agents/\*\*|lib/\*\*|engine.surface|engine_self_modifying" "$f" | grep -iE "engine.surface|skills/\*\*|touches|matches|path" | head -8; done
